[D1] (6:23-6:33) TS377169: Effect.try is called without a `catch` handler, so failures surface as the generic `UnknownError`. The object form `{ try, catch }` maps the cause to a typed, domain-specific error. effect(effectTryWithoutCatch)
  Fix 0: "Disable effectTryWithoutCatch for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable effectTryWithoutCatch for entire file"
  Fix 2: "Add a catch handler (object form)"

--- file:///.src/effectTryWithoutCatch_preview.ts ---
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics effectTryWithoutCatch:warning
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const text: string
export const parsed = Effect.try({ try: () => JSON.parse(text), catch: (cause) => cause })
